<!--{{Ambox}} begin-->{{#switch:{{{small|}}}
| left = 
  {{Ambox/core
  | small      = left
  | type       = {{{type|}}}
  | image      = {{#if:{{{smallimage|}}}
                 | {{{smallimage}}}
                 | {{{image|}}}
                 }}
  | imageright = {{#if:{{{smallimageright|}}}
                 | {{{smallimageright}}}
                 | {{{imageright|}}}
                 }}
  | style      = {{{style|}}}
  | textstyle  = {{{textstyle|}}}
  | text       = {{#if:{{{smalltext|}}}
                 | {{{smalltext}}} 
                 | {{{text}}} 
                 }}
  }}
| #default = 
  {{Ambox/core
  | type       = {{{type|}}}
  | image      = {{{image|}}}
  | imageright = {{{imageright|}}}
  | style      = {{{style|}}}
  | textstyle  = {{{textstyle|}}}
  | text       = {{{text}}}
  }}
}}<!--{{Ambox}} end--><noinclude>
